title: I Reverse Engineered TradingView with AI (Insanely Cool)
description:
Get the free prompt: https://lewiswjackson.com/q/tvclone-desc-l1
Learn how to quant trade with AI (+ $500 trading competition): https://lewiswjackson.com/q/tvclone-desc-l2

A post on X went viral for reverse engineering TradingView. I rebuilt it myself, then put it on steroids with the quant checks I run on my own strategies. You paste one prompt into Claude Code or Codex and it installs on your own computer in about a minute: up to 16 charts, 59 indicators with no cap per chart, drawing tools, alerts with webhooks, a strategy tester, bar replay, a screener, a heatmap, paper trading and an economic calendar. Mac, Windows or Linux.

The quant checks are walk-forward, overfitting (PBO), deflated Sharpe, cost stress, nearby settings and a Monte Carlo of your trades. They tell you whether a backtest was luck before you trust it.
